title: DAPPER-UAV testbed, dataset and code
description: GNS3 emulation testbed (ArduPilot 4.7.1 SITL, MAVLink 2 over WireGuard and IPsec, emulated 5G/LTE/satellite cell sites), processed encrypted C2 traffic of 24 drones with per-bin flight-state labels, the DAPPER federated observer, traffic-shaping defences, sortie-grouped cross-validation, companion-traffic controls, delay analysis and result files.
